messages:
maria-acme: Hey team, ACME's sales reported that promo code ACME100 isn't applying at checkout — it returns "invalid promo". Happening for both new signups and existing customers (order id 98765).
sam-support: Thanks, filing ticket and looking now. Can you DM me a screenshot? cc @nina
maria-acme: Screenshot DM'd. They said it used to grant a 30-day free trial.
sam-support: Reproduced in staging. Checkout call to /v1/promotions/apply returns 400. Pasting minimal repro:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promotions/apply \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"code":"ACME100","account_id":"acme-987","context":{"email":"user@acme.com"}}'
```
Response:
```json
{"error":"invalid_grant","message":"invalid enum value 'free-trial' for field grant_type"}
```

sam-support: Looks like backend rejected the campaign grant_type. This campaign was created via UI last week.
nina: Oof. @kevin-eng can you take a look at validation? Might be a mismatch between the admin UI and backend enums.
kevin-eng: Looking. I see the campaign JSON stored as `grant_type: "free-trial"` (hyphen) in DB. Backend schema expects `free_trial` (underscore). UI allowed the hyphen because of an earlier mapping bug in the admin form. That makes validation fail at apply-time => 400. Not a redemption limit or timezone issue.
kevin-eng: Quick repro query:
```sql
select id, code, grant_type, created_at from promotions where code='ACME100';
-- grant_type = 'free-trial'
```
kevin-eng: Root cause: UI sends an enum value that doesn't match the server enum. Two fixes: 1) server-side tolerant parsing to map hyphen->underscore, 2) migrate stored DB rows to normalized enum. I'll do both (hotfix + migration).
support-bot: Ticket #CS-4721 created and linked to the thread.
kevin-eng: Pushed hotfix that normalizes grant_type during apply processing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8421. Rolling to staging now, will prod promote in 30m behind a feature flag.
nina: Need a migration plan for existing campaigns that used the hyphen. If we only fix at apply-time, stored campaigns should be normalized so UI reads them back correctly.
kevin-eng: Agreed. Running a migration script on a copy first, then we'll run against prod. Migration will convert dashes->underscores for grant_type and validate the resulting enum.
kevin-eng: Migration dry-run:
```bash
python tools/migrate_promotions.py --dry-run --filter "grant_type LIKE '%-%'"
# -> shows 12 rows, including ACME100
```
kevin-eng: Dry-run looks good. Scheduling prod migration + small downtime window for the admin API at 19:00 UTC.
sam-support: Customer notified: "We found the bug and will have a fix pushed tonight; your code will work after a short maintenance." They asked for ETA; gave 19:00 UTC.
engineering-bot: Deployed platform v2.18.3-staging with hotfix at 17:45 UTC.
kevin-eng: Prod migration executed at 19:02 UTC, converted 12 campaigns. Verified ACME100 now shows `free_trial` in DB.
sam-support: Re-tested with ACME: promo now applies and 30-day trial appears on their account. Customer confirmed payment flow success. :tada:
maria-acme: Confirmed — ACME's team says credits/trial now working. Thanks everyone!
nina: Closing ticket after one more hour of monitoring. Will follow up in docs/FAQ to add admin UI validation and an alert if non-standard enum is saved.
sam-support: Noting follow-ups: (1) add client-side validation to disallow hyphen value, (2) add server-side mapping as permanent safeguard, (3) add alert on admin writes that create non-enum values.
support-bot: Ticket #CS-4721 status: resolved.
